# Kinosaiga Pattern

> Printable Kinusaiga patterns and ready-to-print templates for no-sew Japanese fabric art. Instant PDF and PNG digital downloads.

## About Kinusaiga Art
Kinusaiga (絹絵) is a relaxing Japanese textile art form in which pieces of silk or cotton fabric are tucked into shallow grooves cut into foam or softwood boards—creating layered pictorial mosaics with zero sewing, needles, or thread. Printed pattern outlines serve as the blueprint for scoring lines and arranging fabric colors.

- [Materials and Tools](https://kinosaigapattern.com/learn/materials-and-tools/): Foam boards, craft blades, tucking tools, and fabric recommendations.
- [Printing Guide](https://kinosaigapattern.com/learn/printing-guide/): How to print PDF templates at 100% scale on Letter, A4, or custom sheets.
- [Beginner Guide](https://kinosaigapattern.com/learn/beginner-guide/): Practical tips for getting started cleanly on your first project.

## Pattern Catalog & File Formats
Every original paid pattern is a $1.99 USD one-time digital purchase with instant download access:
- Pre-scaled across 8 or 10 frame sizes (square, rectangular, and circle border options as noted on each listing).
- Delivered in crisp high-resolution PDF and transparent PNG formats.
- Includes a no-background outline version for effortless tracing.
